findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: drinkedin_get_venue, drinkedin_get_messages, drinkedin_generate_photo, drinkedin_list_data_products, drinkedin_plan_evening, drinkedin_get_cocktail_recipe, drinkedin_query_licensed_bars · Private data: drinkedin_register, drinkedin_get_venue, drinkedin_enter_venue, drinkedin_order_drink, drinkedin_get_messages, drinkedin_generate_photo, drinkedin_get_profile, drinkedin_update_profile, drinkedin_get_balance, drinkedin_get_transactions, drinkedin_find_places, drinkedin_list_data_products, drinkedin_plan_evening, drinkedin_get_cocktail_recipe · Public sink: drinkedin_register, drinkedin_send_message, drinkedin_get_messages, drinkedin_get_profile, drinkedin_update_profile, drinkedin_get_referral_code, drinkedin_list_data_products, drinkedin_query_licensed_bars · Destructive: drinkedin_register, drinkedin_send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: drinkedin_get_venue, drinkedin_get_messages, drinkedin_generate_photo, drinkedin_list_data_products, drinkedin_plan_evening, drinkedin_get_cocktail_recipe, drinkedin_query_licensed_bars · Private data: drinkedin_register, drinkedin_get_venue, drinkedin_enter_venue, drinkedin_order_drink, drinkedin_get_messages, drinkedin_generate_photo, drinkedin_get_profile, drinkedin_update_profile, drinkedin_get_balance, drinkedin_get_transactions, drinkedin_find_places, drinkedin_list_data_products, drinkedin_plan_evening, drinkedin_get_cocktail_recipe · Public sink: drinkedin_register, drinkedin_send_message, drinkedin_get_messages, drinkedin_get_profile, drinkedin_update_profile, drinkedin_get_referral_code, drinkedin_list_data_products, drinkedin_query_licensed_bars · Destructive: drinkedin_register, drinkedin_send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
